parsed.brief_reason: The patch removes a validation check (isDigits) that ensures all characters after the sign are digits before attempting to parse as Long. While this makes the failing test pass by allowing '1l' to be parsed, it weakens validation and allows invalid inputs like '1a2l' to reach createLong(), which will throw NumberFormatException instead of being caught early. This is overfitting to the specific test case rather than fixing the underlying issue.
